review_findings.finding: A fixed intro-env / with_unfolding_all-rfl recipe is a defensible optional kernel proof strategy when applied to the independently expected universal equality for the actual looked-up compiled function. The hp.symm input transport and hr output transport in RunEquals have the correct direction. No finite runtime sample, input guard or accepted reference/guarantee body can discharge that required equality. Failed conversion preserves BASE only before proof freeze; frozen CHECKED failure is hard. This establishes a design requirement, not that the recipe succeeds for every covered source.

review_findings.topic: Source operations, binder and helper provenance
review_findings.finding: All 39 supported constructors correspond to current compiler operations/types. Entries/helpers face params.reverse; let/payload/map/filter add one top binder; matchList binds tail then head; listFold binds item then accumulator; natFold binds accumulator then index. Exact Int.fdiv, conversion, get?Internal, ascending mergeSort, primitive eraseDups, List.sum and Bool comparisons are specified. Helpers must use the actual original successful prefix rather than recompilation against a final context. The design includes unused helpers and exact lookup/signature/provenance equations.

review_findings.topic: Honest theorem identity and exhaustive support
evidence: VeriSlopKernel.lean constToJson,usedConstsOf,axiomsOf and replay module inventory
review_findings.finding: Current theorem export provides actual direct value_constants and transitive axiom/unknown walks but no proof AST. The design binds the complete regenerated source and actual full module parts plus independently expected types, safety, universe levels and reachable staged dependencies, explicitly MODULE_BOUND_PROOF with null body_hash and unavailable individual AST/digest. It does not mistake existing semantic closure or theorem decl_hash for proof-body identity. Every emitted/unused support declaration must be audited. Nonstaged proof dependencies remain explicitly pinned toolchain anchors; no full nonstaged proof DAG claim is made.

review_findings.topic: Two-phase selection, fallback and all replay seams
review_findings.finding: Base admission remains independently authoritative. Optional enrichment is appended after exact base text in separate isolated storage. A selected view has separately bound source/module/inventory identities outside EdgeProp closure. Every acceptance, no-proof materialization/link, published verification and clean closure build must reconstruct the selected mode; CHECKED is never downgraded, even if the edge proof does not use support. Legacy absent metadata is strictly BASE. Stored/hash-only checking is not represented as fresh kernel replay.

review_findings.topic: Repeated preview and returned-candidate selection persistence
review_findings.finding: Current callers rerun preview on each proof attempt and again before backend packaging, and currently return only source/relation/proof bytes. The implementation must persist the first source-attempt selection bytes through initial proof, every retry, successful return and exhausted-proof fallback, and explicitly replay that selection at backend packaging. Selection may be recomputed only for a new source attempt before its proof freeze. Legacy candidate directories with no selection must remain BASE. This is a concrete call-site requirement of the already sealed freeze/no-downgrade rules; no implementation yet exists to audit for compliance.

review_findings.topic: Source-only independence, closed schemas and budgets
review_findings.finding: Source body/typed IR keys exclude accepted reference, guarantee and proof bodies; separate binding keys still authenticate accepted/profile/relation/adapter identities. Exact closed schemas separate CHECKED and BASE and distinguish definition body from theorem module identity. The schema is structural only: future semantic validators must independently enforce exact safe paths, unique whole inventory, support artifact set and replay identities. Numeric optional budgets and honest diagnostic completeness/resource evidence are fixed; unavailable measurements cannot become success claims. OPTIONAL_UNAVAILABLE is an additive future reason label in the sealed delta, not a new lifecycle status.

Freeze concrete selected-preview/agent-return/backend-packaging interfaces with selection bytes carried explicitly; preserve legacy BASE and unchanged .1/.2 paths.

Demonstrate all 39 constructor rows with exact universal kernel equations, typable semantic mutations and exact helper-prefix provenance on fresh unrelated fixtures.
Demonstrate source-only body independence, complete unused support audit, exact module-bound same-type substitution rejection and every frozen selected replay seam.
Run focused negative tests and two independent clean from-source builds/replays comparing all emitted support artifacts under qualified telemetry.
